# kubernetes — 2023 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 27 kubernetes CVEs of 2023 are in `data/cve/vendors/kubernetes/2023.jsonl`.

### CVE-2023-1174 — [minikube] Network Port exposure in minikube running on macOS using Docker driver
- Assigner: kubernetes | Published: 2023-05-24 | Updated: 2025-01-16 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-266 CWE-266 Incorrect Privilege Assignment
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

This vulnerability exposes a network port in minikube running on macOS with Docker driver that could enable unexpected remote access to the minikube container.

**workarounds:** To continue using an existing cluster, change the default port mappings of the minikube container and restart the docker daemon -

docker run -v /var/lib/docker:/var/lib/docker -e MINIKUBE_CONTAINER_ID="$(docker ps --no-trunc -aqf 'name=^minikube$')" -it --entrypoint /bin/sh alpine
sed -i 's/0.0.0.0/127.0.0.1/g' /var/lib/docker/containers/$MINIKUBE_CONTAINER_ID/config.v2.json

**solutions:** To mitigate these vulnerabilities, upgrade minikube to the latest version and delete any clusters created using an affected version. To delete clusters created using prior versions, run `minikube delete --all`

Affected:
- Kubernetes / minikube: affected 1.26.0 <unspecified (custom); affected unspecified <=1.28.0 (custom)

References:
- https://groups.google.com/g/kubernetes-security-announce/c/2ZkJFMDTKbM

### CVE-2023-2431 — Bypass of seccomp profile enforcement
- Assigner: kubernetes | Published: 2023-06-16 | Updated: 2025-02-13 | Max CVSS: 3.4
- CWE: CWE-1287 CWE-1287 Improper Validation of Specified Type of Input
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 3.4 LOW `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

A security issue was discovered in Kubelet that allows pods to bypass the seccomp profile enforcement. Pods that use localhost type for seccomp profile but specify an empty profile field, are affected by this issue. In this scenario, this vulnerability allows the pod to run in unconfined (seccomp disabled) mode. This bug affects Kubelet.

**solutions:** To mitigate these vulnerabilities, upgrade Kubelet:  https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/cluster-upgrade/ https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/administer-cluster/cluster-upgrade/

Affected:
- Kubernetes / Kubernetes: affected 0 <v1.24.14 (kubelet v1.24); affected v1.25.0 <v1.25.9 (kubelet v1.25); affected v1.26.0 <v1.26.4 (kubelet v1.26); affected v1.27.0 <v1.27.1 (kubelet v1.27)

Credits: Tim Allclair; Craig Ingram

References:
- https://groups.google.com/g/kubernetes-security-announce/c/QHmx0HOQa10
- https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/118690

### CVE-2023-3089 — Ocp & fips mode
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2023-07-05 | Updated: 2024-10-24 | Max CVSS: 7
- CWE: CWE-693 Protection Mechanism Failure
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:L`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

A compliance problem was found in the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform. Red Hat discovered that, when FIPS mode was enabled, not all of the cryptographic modules in use were FIPS-validated.

**workarounds:** Red Hat has investigated whether a possible mitigation exists for this issue, and has not been able to identify a practical example. Please update the affected packages as soon as possible.

### CVE-2023-33234 — Apache Airflow CNCF Kubernetes Provider: KubernetesPodOperator RCE via connection configuration
- Assigner: apache | Published: 2023-05-30 | Updated: 2024-10-10 | Max CVSS: 7.2
- CWE: CWE-74 CWE-74 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.2 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Arbitrary code execution in Apache Airflow CNCF Kubernetes provider version 5.0.0 allows user to change xcom sidecar image and resources via Airflow connection.

In order to exploit this weakness, a user would already need elevated permissions (Op or Admin) to change the connection object in this manner.  Operators should upgrade to provider version 7.0.0 which has removed the vulnerability.



Affected:
- Apache Software Foundation / Apache Airflow CNCF Kubernetes Provider: affected 5.0.0 <=6.1.0 (semver)
- apache / airflow_cncf_kubernetes: affected 5.0.0 <=6.1.0 (custom)

References:
